notes: Fishing you can hear: the reel ticks as it turns, the drag sings when a fish runs, and a tight line hums higher and higher as the strain builds.
Feel it on a controller: a tick on a nibble, a thump on the bite, the fish's weight growing with the strain, and a jolt when it lunges (Options, Display, Controller rumble).
A calmer wait: once your bobber settles, the HUD fades almost away and the view leans in toward the water. Point at the cards to bring them back.
A proper bobber that rocks out little rings, dips on a nibble and gets yanked clean under on a bite.
The lake around your line: fish jumping far out, rings where one rises, rustling reeds, and a damselfly that may rest on your bobber on a fine day.

A smaller reel ring (its how-to lines only for your first ten catches), your angler turning the reel handle, and a catch that hangs in the air for a moment, drips on the way in and gets measured against your record.
